convert_atoms_to_ase: convert an Atoms dataclass to an ASE Atoms object with fixed subsurface atom constraints
convert_relaxation_result_to_ase: convert an AdsorbateSlabRelaxationResult to an ASE Atoms object with energy and forces attached
submit_adsorbate_slab_relaxation: submit a new batch of adsorbate slab relaxations using AdsorbateSlabRelaxationsRequest with a model and adsorbate configs
check_relaxation_status: check the Status enum to determine if a relaxation succeeded, failed, or is not yet available
fetch_relaxation_results: fetch AdsorbateSlabRelaxationsResults to get a list of relaxed adsorbate slab configurations with optional energy and forces
